name: decode_lz_stream_inner_loop
description: Inner decoder loop that reads flag bits, writing literal bytes or copying two to seventeen bytes from earlier output into the destination buffer, stopping at the input limit.

name: decode_lz_copy_then_literals
description: Decoder loop that starts with a back-copy from the window and then alternates literal bytes with copies, stopping at the input or output limit.

key: historyline 1914-1918 (1992)(blue byte)(de)(disk 1 of 7)[a]/Historyline 1914-1918 (1992)(Blue Byte)(De)(Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:install:1:0782
name: decode_lz_offset_copy_loop
description: Decoder loop that takes a copy length from the low nibble of a byte and combines it with the next byte to form a back-reference offset into the window.

key: historyline 1914-1918 (1992)(blue byte)(de)(disk 1 of 7)[a]/Historyline 1914-1918 (1992)(Blue Byte)(De)(Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:install:1:07A0
name: decode_lz_run_length_block
description: Decoder loop that counts down a repeat run and copies from the window, keeping the output count and returning an error marker if the limits are hit.
